items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: you know who held the spot for us, was Adelaide Hall

ctx.x: curtain came down for the intermission, were the greatest. But when we hit the stage, they had never seen that at all. What we were going to do. And, well I don't need to tell you any more from that. But when we started playing our showpiece and the wa-wa even guys doing the wow-wow-and growling and halfway dancing and all like that and doing, and the musicians dancing all like that, it was bedlam. It was really bedlam and, you know who held the spot for us, was Adelaide Hall '41 set the stage up for the band,…
